name: International Energy Agency
role: Publishes critical-minerals market outlooks, demand scenarios and a searchable database of national mineral policies.
initiative: Global Critical Minerals Outlook and policy database
deliveryModel: Research, data and policy analysis for member and partner governments
evidenceNote: Role summarised from the organisation's public mandate. Implementation and evaluated results are not assessed in this profile.

name: UN Trade and Development (UNCTAD)
role: Analyses commodity dependence, trade and the conditions under which producing countries can add and retain value.
geography: Global, with a focus on developing countries
deliveryModel: Research, intergovernmental deliberation and technical cooperation
evidenceNote: Role summarised from the organisation's public mandate. Implementation and evaluated results are not assessed in this profile.

name: Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative
role: Maintains a global standard under which implementing countries disclose information on contracts, licences, payments, revenues and beneficial ownership in oil, gas and mining.
deliveryModel: Country-level multi-stakeholder groups of government, companies and civil society, with independent validation
evidenceNote: Role summarised from the organisation's public mandate. Implementation and evaluated results are not assessed in this profile.
employerNote: Small international secretariat headquartered in Oslo. No staff vacancies were listed at our last check; procurement opportunities are published separately.

passages.quote: The EITI International Secretariat administers entrusted funds on behalf of its donors

name: Natural Resource Governance Institute
role: Researches and advises on how countries govern oil, gas and mineral wealth, including fiscal terms, state-owned enterprises and transparency.
initiative: Natural resource governance research and advice
deliveryModel: Policy research, country engagement and capacity building
evidenceNote: Role summarised from the organisation's public mandate. Implementation and evaluated results are not assessed in this profile.
employerNote: About 80 team members in 19 countries, by its own account. Consultancy listings cover oil and gas as well as minerals, so each needs screening for relevance.

passages.quote: in total we are approximately 80 team members based in 19 countries

name: Business & Human Rights Resource Centre
role: Records allegations of human rights harm linked to companies and invites company responses, including through a tracker focused on transition minerals.
deliveryModel: Public database of allegations and company responses
evidenceNote: Role summarised from the organisation's public mandate. Implementation and evaluated results are not assessed in this profile.

name: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
role: Maintains due diligence guidance on responsible mineral supply chains, widely referenced by regulation and industry schemes.
initiative: Due Diligence Guidance for Responsible Supply Chains of Minerals
deliveryModel: Standards, peer learning and implementation support
evidenceNote: Role summarised from the organisation's public mandate. Implementation and evaluated results are not assessed in this profile.

name: International Labour Organization
role: Sets international labour standards, including on occupational safety and health in mines, and supports governments, employers and workers to apply them.
initiative: Labour standards for mining and industry
deliveryModel: Tripartite standard setting with governments, employers and workers; technical cooperation
evidenceNote: Role summarised from the organisation's public mandate. Implementation and evaluated results are not assessed in this profile.

name: Initiative for Responsible Mining Assurance
role: Operates an independent, third-party audit standard for industrial mine sites, governed jointly by companies, buyers, investors, unions, affected communities and civil society.
deliveryModel: Independent site audits against a multi-stakeholder standard
evidenceNote: Role summarised from the organisation's public mandate. Implementation and evaluated results are not assessed in this profile.
employerNote: No open positions at our last check; the organisation says opportunities arise throughout the year.

passages.quote: We currently do not have any open positions

name: World Bank
role: Finances and advises governments on extractive-sector governance, including through a Climate-Smart Mining initiative.
deliveryModel: Loans, grants, trust funds and technical assistance to governments
evidenceNote: Role summarised from the organisation's public mandate. Implementation and evaluated results are not assessed in this profile.
fundsWhere: Multiple regions, through trust funds and lending.
accessRoute: No open application route for civil-society grants found in our sources. Trust funds are typically accessed through World Bank teams and government counterparts.
whyItMatters: Administers multi-donor trust funds for the extractive sector, and one of them disclosed a grant for citizen engagement.
notEstablished: A trust-fund grant to one organisation does not establish a route that others can apply to.

passages.quote: Support for Citizen Engagement for Accountability and Transparency in the Extractive Sector

name: United Nations Industrial Development Organization
role: Supports inclusive and sustainable industrial development, including work on industrial value chains relevant to minerals.
deliveryModel: Technical cooperation, policy advice and convening
evidenceNote: Role summarised from the organisation's public mandate. Implementation and evaluated results are not assessed in this profile.
fundsWhere: Developing countries, through the A2D Facility.
accessRoute: A2D calls are run through UNIDO's procurement portal when open.
whyItMatters: Administers the A2D Facility, whose 2026 call included recovery and recycling of critical minerals.
notEstablished: UNIDO is the administrator, not the original donor; the A2D money comes from the UK.

passages.quote: The United Nations Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO), with support from the UK Department for Energy Security & Net Zero, has launched a new global call for proposals

name: International Council on Mining and Metals
role: An industry association whose member companies commit to a set of mining principles and performance expectations.
evidenceNote: Role summarised from the organisation's public mandate. Implementation and evaluated results are not assessed in this profile.

name: Global Battery Alliance
role: Convenes companies, governments and civil society on battery value chains, including work on a battery passport.
evidenceNote: Role summarised from the organisation's public mandate. Implementation and evaluated results are not assessed in this profile.
employerNote: Its website links to a careers and opportunities page; we have not yet checked listings there.

name: Centre for Science and Environment
role: An Indian research and advocacy organisation that has examined how District Mineral Foundation funds are governed and spent.
evidenceNote: Role summarised from the organisation's public mandate. Implementation and evaluated results are not assessed in this profile.

name: Council on Energy, Environment and Water
role: An Indian policy research institution that publishes analysis on critical minerals for India's energy transition.
evidenceNote: Role summarised from the organisation's public mandate. Implementation and evaluated results are not assessed in this profile.

name: Mining Advocacy Network (JATAM)
role: An Indonesian network that documents the social and environmental effects of mining and supports affected communities.
deliveryModel: Community-based documentation, campaigning and legal support
evidenceNote: Role summarised from the organisation's public mandate. Implementation and evaluated results are not assessed in this profile.

name: Ministry of Mines, Government of India
role: Sets mining policy for non-fuel minerals, publishes India's critical minerals list and runs central auctions of critical mineral blocks.
initiative: Critical minerals list, auctions and National Critical Mineral Mission
evidenceNote: Role summarised from the organisation's public mandate. Implementation and evaluated results are not assessed in this profile.
accessRoute: Through scheme guidelines published by the Ministry. Application status for the recycling incentive was not established from our sources.
whyItMatters: Funds domestic recycling capacity directly, through capital and operating subsidies to recyclers.
notEstablished: An industrial incentive for recyclers is not a grant route for civil-society or community organisations.

passages.quote: approved a Rs.1,500 crore Incentive Scheme to develop recycling capacity in the country for the separation and production of critical minerals from secondary sources

name: Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources, Republic of Indonesia
role: Regulates mining in Indonesia, including the rules that ended exports of nickel ore.
evidenceNote: Role summarised from the organisation's public mandate. Implementation and evaluated results are not assessed in this profile.

name: Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (UK)
role: UK government department responsible for foreign affairs and development. Recorded here as the funder of a mineral-governance award.
initiative: EMERGE (Ensuring Minerals Enable Responsible Growth and Economic Development), as reported by the recipient
deliveryModel: Grant to an international governance organisation
evidenceNote: Award details come from the recipient's own funder disclosure, not from an FCDO publication.
fundsWhere: Documented here: Africa, with a stated aim of supply-chain resilience.
whyItMatters: A UK development budget line framed explicitly around minerals and supply-chain resilience, delivered through an established governance organisation rather than an open call.
notEstablished: One disclosed award does not show an open FCDO grant route for mineral work, or support for work in Asia on this theme.

passages.quote: Ensuring Minerals Enable Responsible Growth and Economic Development (EMERGE): Supporting sustainable economic development in Africa and the resilience of global supply chains.

name: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero (UK)
role: UK government department. Funds the Accelerate-to-Demonstrate Facility, which UNIDO delivers.
geography: United Kingdom (headquarters); the facility it funds supports projects in developing countries
initiative: Accelerate-to-Demonstrate (A2D) Facility, through the UK Government's Ayrton Fund
deliveryModel: Funds a programme administered by a UN agency
evidenceNote: Role taken from a GOV.UK announcement of the 2026 call.
fundsWhere: Developing countries, through the A2D Facility.
accessRoute: Not directly. Applications go to the A2D Facility through UNIDO's procurement portal when a call is open.
whyItMatters: Shows the difference between a donor and an administrator: the money is British, but applicants deal with UNIDO.
notEstablished: The facility's 2026 call included critical minerals as one of four themes. That does not make the department a general funder of community or worker programmes.

passages.quote: Delivered by UNIDO and funded by the UK Government’s Ayrton Fund, the A2D Facility offers grants from $1–5 million

name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Netherlands
role: Commissions Dutch development-cooperation subsidy programmes that the Netherlands Enterprise Agency administers, including programmes open to mining and critical raw materials value chains.
geography: Netherlands (headquarters); programmes target listed countries in Africa and Asia
initiative: Fair Focus on Trade; Dutch Diamonds Partnerships; European Partnership for Responsible Minerals funding
evidenceNote: Roles taken from RVO programme pages, which name the Ministry as commissioning body.
fundsWhere: Target-country lists differ by programme. Fair Focus on Trade listed 21 countries, including India and Indonesia.
accessRoute: Through RVO programme calls, each with its own eligibility, window and target-country list.
restrictions: Programme rules differ. Fair Focus on Trade excluded for-profit, government and intergovernmental applicants, and applications made on behalf of a consortium.
whyItMatters: One of few public funders whose recent call named mining and critical raw materials as an eligible sector for civil-society capacity in India and Indonesia.
notEstablished: A sector being eligible does not mean any mineral project was funded. Award decisions for the 2026 Fair Focus on Trade round are not recorded here.

passages.quote: Commissioned by: Ministry of Foreign Affairs

name: Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO)
role: Administers subsidy programmes on behalf of Dutch ministries. It runs the application windows, eligibility checks and selection.
geography: Netherlands (headquarters); programmes fund work in listed partner countries
initiative: Fair Focus on Trade; Dutch Diamonds Partnerships; EPRM project funding
evidenceNote: Roles taken from RVO's own programme pages.
fundsWhere: Varies by programme; see each programme.
accessRoute: Applications are made to RVO during each programme's window. Windows open and close; check the programme page.
whyItMatters: If you are applying, this is who you deal with, even though the money comes from a ministry.
notEstablished: RVO administers many programmes unrelated to minerals. Only the programmes linked here are mineral-relevant.

passages.quote: The content of this page has been checked on 19 November 2026

name: Quadrature Charitable Foundation
role: Philanthropic funder. Recorded here because of a disclosed grant for work on the responsible scale-up of transition mineral production.
initiative: Grant to the Natural Resource Governance Institute, August 2024 to July 2027
evidenceNote: Award details come from the recipient's own disclosure. We have not verified the foundation's own website or its current grant-making rules.
whyItMatters: A philanthropic award with an explicitly mineral-focused purpose, which is rarer than general climate or governance support.
notEstablished: Nothing here shows whether the foundation accepts unsolicited proposals, or what else it funds.

passages.quote: To advance efforts by citizens and governments to drive systemic change in the responsible scale up of transition mineral production

name: Gordon and Betty Moore Foundation
role: Philanthropic funder. Recorded here because of a disclosed grant to develop a playbook for nature-positive mining.
initiative: Grant to the Natural Resource Governance Institute, July 2026 to March 2027
evidenceNote: Award details come from the recipient's own disclosure.
whyItMatters: Links mining governance to nature outcomes, a framing that can open conservation funding to mineral-region work.
notEstablished: A design-phase grant to one organisation does not establish a programme or an application route.

passages.quote: To develop a playbook for nature positive mining - Design Phase: Benefits Realization Planning – Shifting Regulatory Regimes

name: Rockefeller Foundation
role: Philanthropic funder. Recorded here because of a disclosed grant for an educational platform on equitable mineral development in low- and middle-income countries.
initiative: Grant to the Natural Resource Governance Institute, September 2025 to November 2026
evidenceNote: Award details come from the recipient's own disclosure.
fundsWhere: The disclosed award concerns low- and middle-income countries.
whyItMatters: Funds capacity and knowledge-sharing for researchers and policy stakeholders, the layer that shapes how mineral policy is designed.
notEstablished: Nothing here shows an open call or a continuing minerals programme.

passages.quote: advancing equitable mineral development in low- and middle-income countries

name: Norwegian Agency for Development Cooperation (Norad)
role: Norway's development agency. Recorded here because of a disclosed grant for civil-society work on resource revenues and just transitions in Africa.
geography: Norway (headquarters); the disclosed award concerns Africa
initiative: Resources to Revenues: Civil Society Driving Just Transitions in Africa, as reported by the recipient
evidenceNote: Award details come from the recipient's own disclosure.
whyItMatters: Revenue governance is how mineral wealth reaches public budgets, so this is relevant even where minerals are not named.
notEstablished: The disclosed purpose names resources and just transitions, not minerals specifically.

passages.quote: Resources to Revenues: Civil Society Driving Just Transitions in Africa

name: European Climate Foundation
role: Philanthropic funder. Recorded here because of a small disclosed grant, from its Pool Fund for International Energy, on copper-sector value addition in Mongolia.
evidenceNote: Award details come from the recipient's own disclosure. A pooled fund combines money from several donors; they are not named in the disclosure.
whyItMatters: Shows small, targeted grants for civil-society capacity on value addition in a mineral sector.
notEstablished: The original donors to the pooled fund are not disclosed in our source.

passages.quote: monitor Mongolia’s copper sector value addition efforts

name: ClimateWorks Foundation
role: Philanthropic organisation with a minerals programme covering responsible mineral development, recovery and recycling, and stakeholder engagement.
evidenceNote: Programme aims taken from the programme page. The page does not describe how organisations can seek funding.
fundsWhere: Not stated on the programme page.
accessRoute: Not described. The programme page refers to working "with our grantees" but gives no application route.
employerNote: At our last check the only listed role was a senior operations position not specific to minerals.
whyItMatters: One of the few philanthropies with a named minerals strategy that spans community engagement and recycling.
notEstablished: A programme strategy does not show that unsolicited proposals are accepted.

passages.quote: With our grantees, we work to ensure a reliable, responsible, and equitable supply of minerals for clean technologies
